# The Cost Segregation Book
> A comprehensive guide to cost segregation studies for real estate investors and tax professionals.

## About
The Cost Segregation Book is a published resource covering the fundamentals and advanced applications of cost segregation studies under IRC Section 168. It explains how building components are reclassified from 27.5-year or 39-year schedules into 5-year, 7-year, and 15-year MACRS classes to accelerate depreciation deductions, including bonus depreciation under IRC 168(k). Written for real estate investors, CPAs, and tax advisors.
